scope.description: Replica construction on the captured snapshot in an environment where the fixed probe address cannot be dialled: the constructor's inline local-address helper is evaluated as an argument to the latency table.
assumptions: the probe address is fixed in the helper rather than taken from configuration
the constructor evaluates the helper unconditionally, whatever the latency configuration
excluded: environments where the probe address is reachable
the latency table's parsing and delay arithmetic

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: harness-only scaffolding: no replica is constructed; the helper is called directly
the call is wrapped in recover() to observe a panic; the replica constructor has no recover around it

plan_uncertainties: the check observes the helper rather than a full replica construction, because construction also needs peer addresses and a listener
whether the project's own deployments always reach the probe address
grounding_unresolved: whether the probe address is reachable in the deployment the project targets
no prerequisite event exists because the helper takes no input; the panic value is the observation
